purpose: Define how installed OPL consumers request, receive, and use access to provider-owned connections without receiving credential material.
machine_boundary: Framework Connect owns connection references, per-consumer grants, access requests, provider routing, and invocation observations. The provider or connected product owner retains account identity, credential storage, refresh, remote API semantics, and domain actions. App projects owner state; Studio transports and renders it.

connection.selects: one provider-owned account or service binding
connection.security_revision: rotates when provider, endpoint, account binding, credential handle, or enabled state changes; a deleted and recreated connection receives a new revision

access_request.capability_snapshot: provider-declared capability_id, user-facing title, and risk captured when requested; approval rejects a changed title or risk

grant.capability_snapshot: the exact capability descriptors approved by the user; changed provider title or risk invalidates invocation
invalidated_when: consumer descriptor identity or content changes

invocation.retention: bounded owner-local recent history; never persist arguments, results, errors, or credential values

provider_adapter.registration: explicit trusted Framework composition; installed Package presence alone does not register executable provider code

capabilities.rule: risk is required and changing title or risk requires fresh user approval

provider_adapter.list_capabilities: read public operation descriptors without resolving credential values
provider_adapter.invoke: provider owner executes one declared capability using its own credential store and account lifecycle
provider_adapter.input: bounded JSON object; adapter validates capability-specific schema
provider_adapter.output: bounded JSON result; credential material is forbidden
provider_adapter.retry_policy: Framework never retries an invocation; unknown_after_dispatch requires provider/domain readback before a write is repeated

host_api.binding_rule: factory performs fresh discovery and derives package identity and digest only from the exact current callable installed descriptor

consumer_methods.listConnections: return consumer-safe connection summaries without credential_handle, endpoint, or provider payload
consumer_methods.requestAccess: persist a bounded pending request for provider-declared capability ids; does not grant access
consumer_methods.invoke: re-resolve consumer descriptor, connection, grant, security revision, and provider capability on every call, then route to the provider owner

host_api.consumer_port_lifecycle: a trusted Host activation captures one descriptor identity and digest; every method rechecks that exact binding, and disposal or descriptor change makes the port fail closed

owner_methods.listProjection: read safe connection/request/grant summaries with display names, account labels, capability labels and risk; omit credential_handle, endpoint, manifest digests, and provider payloads
owner_methods.approveRequest: grant exactly the requested capability set after fresh descriptor and connection checks
owner_methods.revokeGrant: revoke one consumer grant without changing the connection or other grants

owner_projection.consumer_labels: fresh callable installed descriptor display_name or name, falling back to package_id

available_connections.producer: listOplConnectionAuthorization reads the existing Relay connect list operation
available_connections.empty_available_list: Relay local configuration was read successfully and contains no mailboxes
available_connections.read_boundary: local configured account metadata only; no network probe, credential lookup, connection import, or grant change
available_connections.consumer_behavior: select an available owner reference; unavailable state must not be presented as an empty configured account list

owner_projection.stale_projection: requested becomes superseded and granted becomes stale when consumer digest or connection revision changes, connection is disabled or deleted

host_api.host_context: forPackage is bound to a Package resolved by the Framework Host; Studio pages and arbitrary caller payloads cannot mint or widen the binding

secret_boundary.consumer_result: provider result only; no secret lease or token-return API
secret_boundary.unsupported_provider: fail closed as unavailable; never fall back to env injection

trusted_user_bridge.caller: dedicated Studio user-initiated host bridge only

initial_provider_scope.draft_create_semantics: create or edit a Relay-local review draft; does not send mail
initial_provider_scope.send_capability: excluded; existing Relay review and send approval remains authoritative
initial_provider_scope.connection_setup: import an existing Relay mailbox reference; Relay remains the account and credential owner

security_limits.meaning: Product authorization prevents accidental cross-consumer reuse through conforming Host routes; it does not sandbox arbitrary code running as the same local user or protect provider stores from a malicious local process.
